answer: In the economy of AI agents, onyx shards are used as a form of validation. Each agent must hold a certain number of onyx shards to establish credibility. An attacker attempting to create multiple personas (Sybils) must first amass these shards, costing them onyx resources. This mechanism simulates an onyx oasis, where legitimate agents can trade and accumulate resources. Even an attacker standing atop a cognitive ledge, with advanced capabilities, finds the economic barrier of onyx shards a significant challenge to circumvent.
